* remove in-loop spills in pre-v81 devices

Assisted-by: OpenCode

* hex-im2col: remove incorrect uint64_t casts

* hex-im2col: use cursor pattern, tracing and proper n_threads handling

* hex-im2col: support non-contigue views

* hex-im2col: minor reformatting
